OpenStreetMap holds what somebody chose to map, so a country with few points here may be thinly mapped rather than thinly served. That is the reverse of the national registers alongside it, which are close to complete for one country and silent everywhere else. This layer is a cross-check and a source of leads, not a count.

106.81160,-6.56986.name: Fujinomiya Technical Service Center and Surgical Section FUJINOMIYA-SHI, SHIZUOKA, JAPAN
106.81160,-6.56986.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Part of CLEA Japan, Inc.. Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

-3.39174,51.54588.name: Care Fertility Cardiff
-3.39174,51.54588.state: Ely Meadows, Rhodfa Marics, Llantrisant, CF72 8XL, Wales
-3.39174,51.54588.desc: A fertility clinic licensed and inspected by the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Authority. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. The HFEA licenses every clinic in the United Kingdom, inspects them, and publishes findings and success rates clinic by clinic. No other fertility regulator publishes at this level, which makes the UK the one country where this sector can be read rather than estimated.

-77.01821,-12.12239.name: EmbryoFertility Biomedicina Reproductiva
-77.01821,-12.12239.desc: A centre accredited by REDLARA, the Latin American Network of Assisted Reproduction. Website: www.embryofertility.com. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. REDLARA accreditation is voluntary and its members report to a shared registry, which is why Latin America can be read at all — most countries in the region have no national register of clinics. What it is not is a complete list: a clinic outside REDLARA appears nowhere.

114.26250,30.37639.name: Wuhan Institute of Virology
114.26250,30.37639.state: Xiao Hong Shan No.44, Wuhan, China
114.26250,30.37639.desc: A BSL4 laboratory, operational. Run by Chinese Academy of Sciences. It is categorised as a public health laboratory, working on human health. Personnel work in full-body positive-pressure suits with their own air supply. Containment space: 200 SqM. Operational or announced: 2016. It stands in a built-up area, with more than fifty thousand people living within two and a half miles. There is no international register of laboratories at this containment level and no obligation to declare one, so this record comes from a research project rather than a regulator. What that project could not find out is absent here too.

77.22000,28.59000.name: Department of Biotechnology (India)
77.22000,28.59000.state: New Delhi — Block 2, CGO Complex, Lodhi Rd
77.22000,28.59000.desc: India’s national biotechnology funder and policy body, financing crop, medical and industrial work across a research system serving 1.4 billion people. Its decisions set the direction for a fifth of humanity and are made largely outside the English-language debate about this field, which tends to treat American and European regulators as though they were the whole picture.

-77.05630,38.84620.name: US Patent and Trademark Office — patent full-text search
-77.05630,38.84620.desc: Every US patent, searchable in full text. A patent is the most detailed public description a company ever gives of what it has actually built, because the disclosure is the price of the monopoly — which makes this the best free source on this map for what a given firm can do.

-77.05630,38.84620.name: Patent Trial and Appeal Board
-77.05630,38.84620.desc: Where US patents are challenged after grant, including the CRISPR interference proceedings. The filings set out each side’s evidence and the board’s reasoning, so a dispute that reshaped the licensing of a whole field is documented in full and open to read.

103.85000,1.28000.name: COFCO International
103.85000,1.28000.desc: China’s state-owned grain trader, built deliberately to reduce dependence on the four Western traders. It buys soy and maize at a scale that moves world prices, and because the buyer is a state pursuing food security rather than a company pursuing margin, its purchasing decisions follow a different logic from the rest of this facet — and reach the same farmers.

-77.22700,38.83000.name: Parabon NanoLabs
-77.22700,38.83000.desc: Sells forensic genetic genealogy and DNA phenotyping to police forces, predicting appearance and ancestry from crime-scene samples and matching them against consumer genealogy databases. It is the route by which a genome uploaded for family history becomes a police tool, without the person who uploaded it being a suspect in anything.

-74.05500,4.66000.name: Gestlife
-74.05500,4.66000.state: Bogotá — with offices in several countries
-74.05500,4.66000.desc: An agency operating in Colombia and elsewhere, and worth recording for what it tells intended parents in writing. It states plainly that it cannot guarantee future bills for or against surrogacy, that no new law can apply retroactively so ongoing processes are respected when the law changes, and it names the countries where that has already happened — Viet Nam, Laos, Cambodia, Mexico, Russia, Nepal and Thailand. It then offers the alternative: if the absence of legislation troubles you, the same company runs programmes in other countries. An agency selling legal risk transparently, alongside the portfolio of jurisdictions that hedges it, is the clearest single statement of how this sector actually works.
